cohort: 169 pregnant women diagnosed with preterm premature rupture of membranes between 23 weeks and 6 days and 33 weeks and 6 days gestation at Yermool Hospital, from April 2019 to September 2019
finding: There were no significant differences between the four treatment groups in terms of latency period, chorioamnionitis incidence, or neonatal outcomes, suggesting azithromycin may be a viable alternative to erythromycin for managing preterm premature rupture of membranes.
